notes.title: Thank You for over 20,000 Wishlists!
notes.content: [h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477020/cd12c936733ffea79eed2fdc78705fd4c24097ae.gif"][/img][/h3][h3]Now over 20,000 souls have added [b]Forbidden Solitaire[/b] to their wishlists.[/h3][p][/p][h3][i]We extend our gratitude to all of you - despite our growing sense of unease.[/i][/h3][h3] [/h3][p][/p][h3]Grisly and inexplicable events seem to surround this game. As ever, we urge you to proceed with the utmost caution...should you decide to recommend it to those in your circle:[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3414580/Forbidden_Solitaire/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
